summary.headline: Access Bio to buy back KRW 10bn of shares via trust contract, Nov 30, 2026 – Nov 29, 2027
summary.what_happened: On Nov 24, 2026, Access Bio's board resolved to enter into a share buyback trust contract worth KRW 10bn with Korea Investment & Securities as the trust institution, with the contract running from Nov 30, 2026 to Nov 29, 2027 and aimed at stabilizing the share price and enhancing shareholder value. The filing states the company plans to resolve on cancelling the repurchased shares at a shareholders' meeting held after the buyback is completed.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, share buyback trust contracts typically mean a company entrusts a securities firm to purchase its own shares over a set period, which can reduce the number of shares in circulation if the shares are later cancelled. Shareholders are generally affected through changes in share count and per-share value, and such programs are usually framed as measures to support the share price or return value to shareholders.
